@@U04162@@
(Quietly to those in the know.)

@@U04163@@
Now, now,
not to ask where all this came from.
But one thing’s certain,
I haven't been idle,
plundering old armories roundabout.
There they sat on horseback or standing,
believing themselves the lords of creation,
knights and kings and emperors and all,
and yet what are they but empty snail shells
for ghosts and devils to dress up in
and play the Middle Ages.
Well, whatever,
at least it’s no shabby display.

@@U04164@@
(Aloud.)

@@U04165@@
Just listen to them!
Bumping and rattling about in their tin armor,
working up their fierceness in advance!
And there I see tattered flags fluttering,
longing impatiently for a fresh breeze.
Remember,
this is an ancient people you see here,
eager to join even a modern fight.
(A fearsome blare of trumpets from above; a noticeable wavering
in the enemy ranks.)

@@U04167@@
The horizon has gone dark;
here and there an ominous red flash;
the bloody flare of weapons;
everything now joins in:
rocks, forest, air, even the heavens.
translation:
@@U04162@@
（对于知情者来说，请保持安静。）

@@U04163@@
现在，现在，
不要问这一切从何而来。
但有一件事是确定的，
我并没有闲着，
掠夺环岛的旧军械库。
他们或坐在马背上，或站着，
相信自己是造物主，
骑士、国王、皇帝等等，
然而它们不过是空的蜗牛壳而已
供鬼魂和魔鬼装扮
并玩中世纪。
好吧，无论如何，
至少它没有破旧的显示器。

@@U04164@@
（大声）

@@U04165@@
听他们的吧！
穿着他们的锡甲，颠簸、嘎嘎作响，
提前调动他们的凶猛程度！
我看到破烂的旗帜在飘扬，
不耐烦地渴望新鲜的微风。
请记住，
这是你在这里看到的古代人，
渴望加入现代战斗。
（从上面传来可怕的喇叭声；明显的摇摆
在敌人的队伍中。）

@@U04167@@
地平线已暗；
到处都有不祥的红色闪光；
血腥的武器闪光；
现在一切都加入了：
岩石、森林、空气，甚至天空。
